title: Nationwide Clinical Cancer Registry Dataset (oBDS) - Data Schema
description: Table Schema representation of the nationwide oncological basic dataset (oBDS) of the Centre for Cancer Registry Data (ZfKD) at the Robert Koch Institute. In contrast to the XML-based schema of the dataset, this description focuses on the technical implementation. Contains the variables of the clinical cancer registry dataset per entity (Patient, Tumor, OP, Bestrahlung, systemic therapy, etc.) with types, value ranges, and references to the associated classifications. The dataset is extended with variables calculated by the ZfKD (prefix z_).

fields.name: Death Certificate Only flag (derived)

fields.name: Follow-up event sequence number (derived)

fields.name: Days from diagnosis to follow-up event (derived)

fields.name: Predicted substance name (derived)

fields.name: Number of tumors (derived)

title: German Nationwide Clinical Cancer Registry Dataset (oBDS) - Data Schema
description: Table Schema representation of the German nationwide oncology basic dataset (oBDS) of the Centre for Cancer Registry Data (ZfKD) at the Robert Koch Institute. Contains the variables of the clinical cancer registry dataset grouped by entity (Patient, Tumor, Surgery, Radiotherapy, Systemic therapy, etc.) with types, value ranges, and references to the relevant classifications. The dataset is extended with variables computed by ZfKD (prefix z_).
